claims.content: The Auctioneer has searched for and selected a list of auction products.
The Auctioneer is on the 'Create New Auctions Page' or 'View / Edit Current & Scheduled Auctions Page'.
The product to be scheduled must have an available image to display.
The product must be in a valid, sellable inventory location.

If any of the items being scheduled have additional quantities of the same item already scheduled in overlapping auction events, the system should provide a warning (preferably via a popup window) to the Auctioneer before the auction is created.
The Auctioneer can choose to schedule alternative durations by manually choosing starting and ending dates/times instead of selecting from the standard durations.
The selected SKUs are scheduled for auction with the defined parameters (event name/profile, schedule, and parameters).
The system has saved the changes to the event profile if one was edited or created.
If an error occurred due to overlapping start and end dates/times, the system highlighted the offending data and displayed an error message.
